title: Beta customer rollout readiness matrix & KPI sentinel
content:
Summary:
This sheet is the working readiness matrix for the upcoming beta customer cohort (Nov 2025 -> Mar 2026). Purpose: capture per-customer readiness, primary risks, KPI baselines and go/no-go thresholds, and an operational "sentinel" (automated alert rules + owner actions) for launch days and first-week ramp. Doc status: working tracker + notes for product ops, solutions, and SRE to align on contingency steps.

Matrix (rows = customers):
Customer | Segment | Target cohort size | Readiness score (0-100) | Primary blockers | Mitigation plan | KPI signals (baseline -> target) | Go / No-Go criteria | Escalation owner (SLACK) | Dry-run date | Notes
---
Acme.ai | AI-native startup | 250 users | 86 | SDK integration latency for embed endpoints (~180ms) | Spike tests with Dedicated routing; enable KV caching + reduce batch size | Gen tokens/day: 18k -> 27k; Median latency: 220ms -> <180ms | Median latency under 250ms for 95% p95 traffic; no data exfil alerts | Ethan Morales (@ethan) | 2025-11-19 | Customer wants canary region; needs fallback to hosted model 1.
NovaHealth | Regulated SMB | 80 users (PHI) | 72 | Private deployment compliance checklist incomplete (audit logs) | Accelerate KMS integration; run audit log export test with security | API errors/day: 0.6 -> <0.2; Audit export success: 0% -> 100% | Audit export validated and legal sign-off | Kayla Chen (@kayla) | 2025-12-02 | Legal to confirm retention windows.
FinFlow | Fintech mid-market | 150 users | 63 | Throughput degradation when seq_len spikes; quantization mismatch | Apply model variant v2-quant and set traffic cap; schedule dedicated capacity window | Throughput (req/s): 85 -> 150; Cost/token: $0.0024 -> $0.0018 | No more than 3 sustained >20% degradation events in 24h during dry-run | Lars Petrov (@lars) | 2026-01-11 | Need updated cost forecast for sales.
EduSpark | Edtech pilot | 40 users | 79 | Onboarding UX flows incomplete (consent + logging UI) | Ship consent modal + automated onboarding checklist; provide SDK example | Activation rate: 32% -> 55%; Error rate: 2.7% -> <1% | Activation >=45% and errors <1.5% post-canary | Marta Ruiz (@marta) | 2025-12-15 | PM to run 2 onboarding sessions.

Readiness scoring rubric (how score computed):
- Integration completeness (30%) — SDK installed, auth keys, webhooks validated.
- Ops readiness (25%) — runbook assigned, escalation path, dry-run scheduled.
- Security/compliance (20%) — KMS/HSM, audit logging, data residency checks.
- KPI alignment (15%) — baseline measurement captured and targets agreed.
- Risk mitigation (10%) — contingency steps identified and owner assigned.
Scores are rounded to nearest integer.

KPI Sentinel (automated rule set):
We will configure a lightweight "KPI sentinel" for the first 72 hours after each go-live to surface regressions early. Rules below are minimum; product, SRE and CS must agree final alert thresholds before enabling. Each rule maps to an action in the playbook.
Rules:
1) Latency spike rule: If p95 latency increases >25% vs baseline for >10 minutes -> Pager to SRE on-call (P1), throttle non-critical background requests, enable canary fallback to lower-cost model variant.
2) Error-rate rule: If error rate (4xx+5xx) >1.2x baseline or >1% absolute for 5 minutes -> Notify on #prod-ops, open Jira with priority tag, roll traffic back to previous model version.
3) Quality regression (sampling): For every 500 requests, sample 20 outputs and run automated evals (prompt set). If semantic score drops >6 points vs baseline for 3 consecutive samples -> Pause rollout and start investigation.
4) Cost anomaly: If cost per token increases >30% vs expected for 2 consecutive hours -> Alert finance + product; apply temporary rate limit to heavy API keys.
5) Compliance failure: If audit export fails or encryption pool reports >0 failures -> Immediate block on ingest for affected tenant until resolved.

Mapped playbook actions (short):
- Stage 1 (Detect): automatic alerts -> SRE triage within 10 minutes.
- Stage 2 (Contain): roll traffic to fallback model / enable burst capacity / toggle caching off/on.
- Stage 3 (Mitigate): engage solutions eng for SDK patch, notify customer success, schedule hotfix deploy.
- Stage 4 (Recover & Learn): postmortem within 72 hours; update runbook; notify customer and sales.

Contingency templates (snippet to copy into runbook):
- "Fallback to hosted: enable routing policy 'hosted-fallback' and set capacity to 30% for beta cohort. Confirm p95 latency is stable for 30m before incrementing traffic."
- "Throttle heavy keys: apply per-key rate limit config: 120 req/min for non-critical endpoints; notify account owner."
- "Compliance pause: execute 'pause-ingest' script, generate signed audit dump, engage security immediately."

Open questions & risks (work-in-progress):
- Does sales need an updated MRR estimate for FinFlow given predicted Dedicated cost offset? (assigned to Lars)
- Legal sign-off for NovaHealth retention policy — on legal's calendar for Nov 20.
- Do we have central sampling evaluation infra production-ready for Quality regression rule? If not, fallback to manual sampling. (Action: Priya + Applied ML)
- Are there any quotas on customers that would block enabling KV caching? (Infra to confirm)

Next immediate steps (week-by-week):
Week 1 (now -> Nov 16): finalize sentinel thresholds; run Acme dry-run; validate audit export for NovaHealth.
Week 2 (Nov 17 -> Nov 23): FinFlow quant test on staging; ship EduSpark onboarding modal; update release notes.
Week 3 (Nov 24 -> Dec 01): cross-team / sales enablement; legal sign-off; schedule production cutover windows.

Quick links / references (working):
- Beta rollout playbook (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/Beta+Rollout+Playbook
- Dry-run checklist (doc): https://drive.redwood.ai/dry-run-checklist
- Runbook template (github): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/tree/main/templates

Notes to self (rough):
- Keep this sheet as the single source for who owns each mitigation. Avoid splitting into multiple lists.
- Expect multiple iterations on sentinel thresholds after first dry-runs; start conservative then loosen.
- For customers with PHI, require encryption test sign-off from security before go.

Changelog (summary):
- 2025-11-03: initial draft matrix (Priya)
- 2025-11-18: added Acme dry-run details and latency mitigation (Ethan)
- 2025-12-01: NovaHealth legal status updated (Kayla)
- 2026-02-14: updated FinFlow cost mitigation and moved to in_review (Priya)
